sources.entry: Review Board - Extensible and friendly code review tool for projects and companies of all sizes. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: Review Board is an open source, web-based code and document review tool for tracking changes, diffs, and review discussions across many version control systems.
summary.what_it_does: Review Board tracks pending changes to code, graphics, and documents, along with the discussions behind them. Its diff viewer shows syntax highlighting, interdiffs, moved-line detection, and indentation change indicators. It supports Bazaar, ClearCase, CVS, Git, Mercurial, Perforce, Plastic, and Azure DevOps, hosted on your own server or on several named hosting services. A rich API and extension framework let users build custom features and review UIs without forking. RBTools, a separate command line suite, is used to post changes for review and land reviewed changes.
use_cases: code review for a development team
reviewing patches and diffs before merging
self-hosted review of Git or Mercurial changes
posting and landing changes from the command line with RBTools
extending a review process through a web API
how_to_run: Follow the interactive installation guide linked from the README to download and install Review Board
Install RBTools from the README link for command line use
notable: Diff viewer with interdiffs and moved-line detection
Extension framework and web API for custom integrations
Supports many version control systems including Git, Mercurial, Perforce, and CVS
Related projects include ReviewBot for automated review and rb-gateway for Git repository management
caveats: Some features such as report generation, PDF and Office document review, and GitHub Enterprise integration require the paid Power Pack add-on, which needs a license
Hosted option RBCommons is offered by the maintainers; self-hosting requires installing and administering the server
The README does not accept pull requests; patches go through reviews.reviewboard.org
